reviewNotes: ADMIT-BACKSTAGE. Current Omantel standard agreement resolves Hayyak lifecycle: prepaid validity is 90 days from first call or recharge/balance transfer, followed by another 90-day number holding period; recharge during grace starts a new validity period. Omantel supports Hayyak eSIM with passport/ID/residence-card upload, online/app recharge/payment, and free incoming SMS while roaming. The currently listed e-voucher floor is OMR7; exact cheaper qualifying balance-transfer mechanics and China-specific partner/OTP reliability remain unresolved.

events.outcome: Current Omantel agreement establishes 90-day prepaid validity plus a 90-day number-holding period; current Hayyak supports passport eSIM acquisition, card/app recharge and free incoming SMS while roaming.

data.acquisitionSummary: Omantel currently sells Hayyak prepaid and supports eSIM for Hayyak. The eSIM flow accepts ID, passport or residence card plus a personal photo/signature and payment, establishing a current passport-capable digital acquisition flow. Tourist SIM is a separate local-only product and is not substituted for ordinary Hayyak.

keep.action: Omantel standard terms give prepaid 90 days of validity from the first call or any recharge/balance transfer, then another 90-day number holding period. Recharging during grace starts a new validity period. The current listed e-voucher denominations start at OMR7, so OMR7 per 90-day active cycle is the conservative documented recharge floor; cheaper balance-transfer possibilities are not modeled.

data.chinaActivation: Digital Hayyak eSIM acquisition supports passport upload, but this review does not prove China-first activation or remote fulfillment from mainland China.
data.kyc: Omantel eSIM onboarding accepts ID, passport or residence card plus a personal photo and signature.
data.payment: Omantel prepaid supports online/app recharge and says credit/debit cards are accepted. Exact foreign-card execution remains unverified.
data.wifiCalling: Current new Hayyak plans support local VoWiFi; abroad setup/use was not reconciled.
data.roamingSms: Omantel states incoming SMS while roaming is free of charge and Hayyak roaming is available internationally. China-specific roaming partner availability and third-party OTP reliability remain unverified in this bounded review.
data.tariffSummary: 90-day active prepaid validity from call/recharge/balance transfer, then 90-day number holding; current listed e-vouchers start at OMR7. Passport eSIM and free incoming roaming SMS are documented.
guideSteps: Acquire ordinary Hayyak/eSIM through the current Omantel flow; do not substitute the 30-day local-only Tourist SIM for the long-term route.
Recharge within 90 days for a clean active-state cycle; the later 90-day holding period is recovery, not the preferred keep-alive target.
Treat free incoming roaming SMS as carrier capability, not proof of China-specific OTP delivery.
